与购物一起成长(Growing up with shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的B1记叙文:本的经历、感受与成长。

At first, Ben found it difficult to keep the habit. Ben ordered rice and water at the cashier last night. Ben has practiced table tennis for three years and won a prize last term. A wobbly wheel slowed the trolley.

Ben will take part in a table tennis match in May. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. People around Ben often share different ideas about the online shop. In fact, the boxer's dazzling footwork kept his opponent off balance.
On Tuesday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. The online shop looked quieter than usual that evening. Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. Faulty items get a full refund.
There are always more possibilities than we expect. Ben thanked David for the honest advice. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. Our friendly new neighbor is Ukrainian.
They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. The experience taught Ben more than any book could. Little by little, things began to change.
